method: Same compiler/Qt Release builds; original source baseline; 3 alternating trials; each lookup result is median of 7 batches of 100 byIds({1,2500,5000}) calls in a synthetic 5000-row DB; wakeups observed from QAbstractEventDispatcher in a 2-second LocalSpeech-only event loop. No concurrent build or CTest; a separate mostly-hidden synthetic soak and the existing user app may still be running. Not whole-app CPU, frame rate, cloud latency or leak proof.
